text:
maria: Heads up — planning to deploy runtime-3.5-opt in ~2h (20:00 PDT). Canary -> small ramp. Need quick predeploy sign-offs: smoke owner, rollback owner, and a perf check window. TL;DR checklist below, pls ack by 19:45.

maria: Predeploy checklist (quick):
- [ ] Confirm no migrations
- [ ] Rollback owner assigned
- [ ] Smoke script ready + owner
- [ ] Canary toggle staged
- [ ] Observability alerts smoke-tested
- [ ] Holdback window/contacts listed

ken: I can be rollback owner. I’ll keep the rollback playbook open and standby. No DB migrations in this change (confirmed with infra). :white_check_mark:

oliver: I’ll run smoke and perf checks. Smoke script lives in ops/smoke/runtime-3-5.sh. Quick smoke command (will run 19:50):
```bash
# sanity + latency check
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' -d '{"input":"smoke token ping"}' | jq .
# run 1-min rps profile
./ops/smoke/runtime-3-5.sh --rps 50 --duration 60
```

sylvia: Canary toggle already staged in feature-flag service. I’ll flip at 20:00 to 1% then follow ramp policy. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.io/dashboards/canary/runtime-3-5

anya: Quick note re SLOs — if 95p latency > 450ms for >3m during canary, we abort and rollback. Also watch token cost spike. I’ll watch alerts.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary toggle for runtime-3.5-opt at 2024-06-15T20:00:00Z (scheduled by maria)

maria: Also calling out rollback steps in case:
1) revert feature flag -> 100% back to runtime-3.4
2) scale down new pool and drain
3) pin traffic to proven variant
Ken, will you run rollback if needed?

ken: Yep — if we abort I’ll trigger revert flag and notify infra to drain. I’ll also open a quick incident channel if we hit >5% error rate.

oliver: Small request — can we disable autoscaler burst for the first 10m of canary? Burst could hide cold-start regressions. If ops agrees, please set policy to static for 10m.

sylvia: Good call. Setting autoscaler to static for 10m at toggle. Noted.

maria: Great. Final acks please (just one word): roll owner, smoke owner, observability, and release owner.

ken: rollback: ack

oliver: smoke: ack

anya: observability: ack

sylvia: flag ops: ack

maria: release owner: ack :shipit:

maria: Plan: 20:00 1% for 15m -> 10% for 15m -> 50% for 20m -> full if green. Everyone on pager for first 45m. If no objections by 19:45 we proceed.

oliver: I’ll post smoke run results in this thread at 19:55.

ken: I’ll be on standby at 19:45-21:15.

sylvia: Toggling schedule confirmed.

maria: Thanks team — logging this thread for the cutover. If anything changes, ping here. :memo:
